description.fun: Yveltal, the mascot of Pokémon Y, is the Legendary Pokémon of destruction: it spreads its wings and tail feathers to drain the life energy of everything around it, and it tends to appear wherever there's conflict. At the end of its life it takes the life of all around it, then wraps itself in a cocoon and sleeps. Its silhouette is shaped like the letter Y.
description.guide: Yveltal is a Dark- and Flying-type Legendary Pokémon and the mascot of Pokémon Y, a bird-like creature shaped like the letter Y that represents death and destruction. It absorbs life energy with its outstretched wings and falls into a cocoon-like sleep when its life ends. With Xerneas it keeps the balance of life and death.
description.tagline: The life-draining bird of destruction from Pokémon Y
